line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

decision: R1191 partially restored: retain package system directory substitution, restore original condition. The real provider uses a MAX_PATH scratch buffer and returns at most 259 bytes for this 520-byte destination. With 9 suffix bytes and NUL, maximum total is 269. R1185 now includes the public Win32 registry projection directly; the native NT alias layer had no consumer here. R1194 retains MAX_PATH+12 to match GetPIFConfigFiles. R1195 retains optional-key omission pending owner: missing virtual VDD key is supported, allocation failure is also silenced; no claim the latter is required. Keep owner-approved DIV-134 empty AddSystemFiles body; reduce its comment. Original creation of real host boot-root files remains excluded.

verification.provider: Actual directory-provider function bodies with a fixture session root and native filesystem. Valid path lengths 96,258,259 accepted, 260 and absent directory rejected. Both old and original caller predicates agree for all five. Real provider + real session also passed the official media fixture against the staged package.
verification.symbols: dumpbin /symbols of final nt_msscs.obj shows NtvdmGetSystemDirectoryA and shadow registry open/query-info/query-value/close; no direct ADVAPI32 registry operations.
